tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/
༄༅/ /sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gyi blo gros ma'i rang bzhin de'i sgrub mchod kyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i lag len 'di la 'jug par 'dod pas/ rje btsun zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub mchod kyi tshig don gnyis ka blo la nges por bya'o/ /'og gzhi'i dkyil 'khor la padma 'dab brgyad/ lte bar chos 'byung can/ me long la chos 'byung rkyang pa dga' 'khyil bzhi dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi cha la gtso mo'i sngags yig 'bru rnams brtsegs pa dang*/ de'i g.yas phyogs su bai ro tsa na'i sngags dang*/ g.yon du barṇa'i sngags rnams brtsegs te 'bri/ gzhan mdun bskyed kyi bshams la khyad par med/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi mdun du tsandan dmar po'i lde gus byugs pa'am/ phye ma bkram pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu gsum pa/ gtor phran gcig dang mchod par bcas pa bshams/ cho ga'i rim pa la/ oṃ sumbha nas bzung*/ 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim gyi bar dang*/ nang mchod/ sumbha sa bsangs nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyi bar bdud rtsi'i dbus su chos 'byung gi lte bar hrīḥzur gsum la g.yon bskor gyi/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad dang*/ khyad par rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi byang chub kyi sems su spyan drangs te thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hri/ bdag dang gnas la bdud rtsi gtor/ oṃ hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣtan hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ bgegs rnams thams cad tshar bcad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du srung ba'i 'khor lo grub par gyur/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo nas/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams kyi rgyas btab par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa= oṃ badzra shuddho3= oṃ yo ga shuddho= stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lte bar raṃ yig dmar po gnas pa las/

ye shes kyi me 'od 'phros/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan cing*/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa'i phyi rol phyogs bzhir/ dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dbus su/ dri bral chu skyes dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo 'og tu zla ba dang*/ steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kha sbyor gyi dbus su hrīḥyig dmar ser ro/ /de las gri gug hriḥs mtshan pa/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug cung zad thur du sdigs pa'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ g.yon thod khrag steng phyogs su gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ phyi rol g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po bsgrengs pa sku'i g.yon ngos su rdo rje rab bsngags ma ljang khu zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ phyag g.yas thod khrag 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gri gug thur du sdigs pa/ g.yas su rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma ser mo zhabs g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba/ phyag g.yon thod khrag 'phyar zhing*/ g.yas gri gug thur du sdigs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum kar yang gcer bu mo dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal cung zad gdangs shing ha har bzhad pa/ khro gnyer bskyod pas 'jigs pa yang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur grol ba/ lang tsho la bab cing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang bar/ chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje rab bsngags ma'i gsang bar/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ oṃ badzra barṇa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje rnam snang ma'i gsang bar/ chos 'byung gi nang du/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsegs ma rnams te/ chos 'byung rnams dmar po/ sngags rnams lha rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa/ 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ / gtso mo'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang nyid kyi mgrin pa nas bcad pas/ rtsa a ba dhu tī dang rkyang ma dang*/ ro ma gsum chad pa na/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams rgyun chad/ ma rungs pa thams cad shin tu skrag par gyur/ phyag g.yon pas dbu skra'i phyed nas bzung*/ spyan gsum thur du gzigs pas sa 'og gi 'jig rten bskyod par byas/ rtsa gsum bcad mtshams kyi a ba dhu tī nas me dang mun pa'i rang bzhin khu rdul 'dres pa'i rgyun byung ste/ gtso mo rang nyid kyi zhal du 'jug par gyur/ g.yon rkyang ma nas mi bskyod pa dang 'dres pa'i kunda'i rgyun byung ste/ g.yon rdo rje rab bsngags ma'i zhal du babs/ ro ma nas/ rang byung dang 'dres pa'i rakta'i rgyun byon pa/ g.yas rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma'i zhal du babs/ lha sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'o/ / 'dir sngags gsum po mang nyung ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /thur sel gyen du drangs pa'i sbyor ba las/ gtso mo'i gsang bar gnas pa'i sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa gsum gyi lam nas byung*/ g.yon gyi rdo rje rab bsngags ma 'od zer gyis drangs te/ bdag nyid la thim/ badzra barṇa'i skabs rkyang ma nas zhugs te/ gtso mo'i gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du/ gtso mo nyid kyi sngags kyi g.yon du/

sngar gyi rnam pas bzhugs par gyur/ g.yas kyi rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma yang 'od zer gyis drangs/ rang nyid la thim/ bai ro tsa na'i sngags/ ro ma'i lam nas brgyud/ gsang ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du/ gtso mo'i sngags kyi g.yas su sngar gyi rim pas 'khod/ gtso mo nyid kyi dbu yang rang gnas su byon/ gcig tu 'brel bar gyur/ rang gi mdun gyi maṇḍal la dmigs te/ sumbha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba ces pa nas/ sku mdog dang mtshungs pa 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ / zha ེ sa pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo zhes pa bor/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo nas/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams su gyur/ phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul bzhin du/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra barṇa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ zhes g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis me tog phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ puṣpe nas shapta 'i bar gyis 'bul/ nus na de thams cad la sngags gsum po re re bzhin/ mchod sngags sbyar te 'bul ba yin no/ /de bzhin du sngags gsum po re re'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ oṃ ḍi ya pulli ra ma gi ti kā ma kṣaṃ shi haṭṭa/ dharma sambho ga ni rma ṇa mahā su kha kā ya na maḥ ces pa lan gsum gyis bstod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nas/ rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / 'og ma'i bar bya/ gtor ma 'bru gsum lan bdun sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ badzra a ralli hoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya ho/ lan bdun gyis phul/ sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod de/

mdun bskyed kyi sngags gsal btab/ rlung phyir bsal/ yang sngags gsum tshar gcig brjod/ rang gi sngags gsum gsal btab/ rlung nang du rngubs/ thur sel steng du bskyod pa'i sbyor bas/ rang gi gsang ba'i sngags gsum las 'do zer 'phros/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yas pa nas thon/ mdun gyi lha mo gsum gyis shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs sku lus kyi nang gang*/ gsang ba'i sngags las 'od zer nyams bde ba dang ldan pa spyan drangs/ rang rang gi shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ bdag nyid kyi sna g.yon gyi sgo nas zhugs/ a ba dhū ti'i lam brgyud/ gsang bar gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi sngags gsum la thim/ dmigs pa de nyid yang yang gsal btab cing*/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa yang lhag por bsnan te/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ badzra barṇa nī ye/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ slar yang gong bzhin arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma gsum yang 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha= mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dkyil 'khor 'og ma hūṃ las byung ba'i nas/ de rnams kyi dbus su hrīḥ yi ge de rnams las nas/ chos 'byung gru gsum kha dog dmar ba/ bde ba chen po'i nas bar snang la dbus su oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ g.yon du*/ oṃ badzra barṇa nī ya hūṃ phaṭa/ g.yas su / oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge brtsigs ma rnams so/ /phyi rol phyogs bzhir nas/ gcig tu 'dres pa las/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba zhes pa nas 'od zer 'bar ba'o/ /lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo nas/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo/ /phaiṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ yo ga shuddho3= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ swāhā nas/ shapta āḥhūṃ

gi bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs/ shlo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ bar 'dir oṃ sarba buddha sogs sngags gsum so sor cung zad bzlas nas/ mthar gcig tu dril ba gong bzhin bzla bar bya'o/ /mthar sumbha dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang cung zad bzlas/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gsung rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs zhes pa nas/ gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ / zha ེ sa pa'i bar du zhal gnyis ma'i cho ga bzhin no/ /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ badzra barṇa nī ye/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye i daṃ puṣpe sogs kyis 'bul ba nas/ kun 'grub shog /ga ོnga ma'i bar dang*/ kha kha khā hī khā hi nas/ yig brgya lan gsum bar gyi gtor chog byas/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs nas/ yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba nas/ yo ga shuddho'i bar gong mdun bskyed bzhin/ de nas arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod pa sogs/ cho ga lhag ma rnams zhal gnyis ma'i skabs dang khyad par med de/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i skabs su sngags gsum so so dang ci rigs par sbrel ba ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bdag 'jug gi rim pa yang*/ phal cher mtshungs te/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sumbha bzla ba'i bar/ lte bar oṃ baṃ nas/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes pa nas/ nyams par 'gyur ta re/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig pa nas/ a a hri hri swāhā 'i bar/ tiṣṭha badzra nas/ mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur/ /padma'i gdan ni nyon mongs pa ma gos pa'o/ /'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan ma ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa spangs pa'o/ /nyi ma ni bde ba chen po'i nas/ thabs dang ma bral ba'o/

/lha gsum ni chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'o/ /dbu bcad pa ni sgrib pa thams cad spangs pa'o/ /rtsa gsum bcad pa ni/ nyon mongs pa gsum dang*/ khams gsum rnam par dag pa'o/ /gcer bu ni rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /me dpung 'bar ba ni kun tu khyab pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba spro ba'o/ /'og gi gzhi'i chos 'byung ni/ dug gsum gyi chos nyid ces pa nas/ ye shes dang yon tan rgyas pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba'o/ / dngos gzhi'i maṇḍal 'bul ba nas / ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku mngon du gyur/ zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las / rang skad cig gi bcom ldan 'das ma sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi skur gyur/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i gnas su/ gsum dril ba'i snying po 'jug pa ni khyad par ro/ /chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po rtsa ba phra ba zha ེ sa pa nas/ gcig tu 'brel bar gyur gyi bar/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i nas/ shapta 'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ sngags kyi thad 'don pa sgyur ro/ / gtso bos ji ltar/ maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ bkra shis kyi mthar thug par/ rjes chog kyang 'dra ba las/ 'don pa sgyur ba phran tshegs rnams dran par bya'o/ /de ltar na sku gsum rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub mchod kyi rim pa ngag 'don ma bden gnyis zhal can gyi cho ga la 'don pa sgyur ba 'di yang*/ blo gros shin tu dman pa rnams la dgos par byung nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag/ bkrashis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sku gsum rdo rje phag mo zhes bya ba dbu bcad mar grags pa'i sgrub mchod ngag 'don bzhugs/ - PAGE 192 -- PAGE 187 -- PAGE 186 -
